title: Faulty monitor detection

labels.name: bug
labels.description: Bug reports and bugfix pull requests

body:
I post this as a notice more than anything else, it may have just been faulty device configuration and preventing the issue from GLFW's side is not warranted.

We've had a user get crashes during GLFW mode retrieval in our application and silent quits of the GLFW modes test since version 3.1. glfwinfo and modes output for various GLFW versions follows (3.1.2 is current master).

The name for his monitor was reported blank in 3.0, which seems to bother 3.1 and above. Deleting his two monitors and letting the system install them back fully resolved the issue for all versions (he didn't report ever having any issues with his monitors in other applications).
